The seam pins `matchLacksRevealProjection` as **async** returning `false`; B14-0 must implement it as a Promise-returning function and `await` it at every call site, otherwise the seam's Promise is truthy and the four suites would (loudly) refuse. Lobby/invite summaries (`joinableLobbies.ts:159,182`) publish `fogOfWar` for joinable lobbies to anyone, by design; the metadata route's non-disclosure therefore protects active/completed matches, not open lobbies (CF-B14A-8). `GET /api/matches/[id]` (post-battle report, unauthenticated) is the local combat-resolution surface, not a multiplayer journal read; out of B14 scope. Campaign routes read campaign streams only.
orderingBullets: Metadata (`src/pages/api/multiplayer/matches/[id].ts:99-104`): authenticate -> getMatchMeta -> participant (host or occupied human seat) -> fog predicate -> serialize. Non-participants and spectators get the pre-existing generic 404 body; the fog branch is unreachable before the participant check. Reads and status codes for a stranger are identical to Main (same single store read), so no timing or body oracle is added. Known-off and flag-omitted: identical bytes (`{ meta }`), pinned by the retained multiplayerMatchMeta rows.

History chain: `ViewerHistoryService.exportForViewer` resolves the viewer through `authorizeHumanAction` (durable seats; `HostAsGmMembershipSource` still requires an inner seat row) before `projection.project`; `FogAwareMatchProjectionService.projectWithIdentities` (`FogAwareMatchProjection.ts:275-286`) reads config, and on refusal verifies brand+scope and the durable current seat, then throws `projection-failed` / `fog-projection-unavailable` before `super.projectWithIdentities` (the only journal reader), before `auditRepo.readBySession`, before `collectPrivateExportViews`, and before the export route's `readMatchHistoryLineage`. History pages (`projectWithCursor`) call `projectWithIdentities` before `resolveEpoch`/`assignSequences`, so no epoch is minted on refusal. No raw fallback exists: `matchConfig` maps any read failure to `undefined`, which the predicate refuses; the `heads` projection-metadata dependency is no longer read at all, so an unavailable effective head cannot refuse a known-off match (pinned at matchHistoryFog.test.ts:634).

One ordering nuance at the service level only (F3): config is read before the brand/scope check that the parent performs first, and an unbranded viewer is answered `wrong-session` on fog-on versus `not-a-viewer` on fog-off. Unreachable through any HTTP route (every caller brand-checks first) and not a non-member disclosure, but it is a service-level fog oracle for a future direct caller. Low.

authority.finding: **Authority.** Membership precedes policy on both surfaces (metadata participant check; history resolver with durable seats, then the service's own seat re-check). Host/GM privilege is not a fog exemption (GM-without-seat refused 403; host private-preview refused 500). No new authority is granted to anyone; the only change for authorized viewers is refusal. Spectators remain non-participants of the metadata route.

replay.finding: **Replay.** No event, journal, or reducer change; the fog-on effective-head read is removed with the served projection, and fog-off still reads the root branch exactly as Main (CF-S-1 untouched). No derived state is persisted or changed.

idempotency.finding: **Idempotency.** Every refusal path is read-only: no epoch resolved, no sequences assigned, no private-access audit written, no match row updated. Repeated refusals are byte-identical.

concurrency.finding: **Concurrency.** Fog config is immutable after creation (no update path) so the config-then-seat reads cannot straddle a toggle; the metadata route uses a single meta read. Seat revocation between the resolver and the service re-check only tightens (second check refuses). The unused per-request `SQLiteEventHistoryBranchStore` construction is wasteful but harmless.
